concerns.text: User Story US4 (Privacy Auditing) has no associated Success Criteria. All other user stories are linked to at least one SC (e.g., SC-002 for US1, SC-001 & SC-009 for US2, SC-003 for US3). The absence of a success criterion for US4 leaves the story under‑specified and provides no measurable target for the privacy audit requirement (FR-005).
